competencies.topic: Sustain 5S by criteria, assigned ownership, leading by example, patrol and improvement
Purpose, before/after/periodic inspection, real execution and records, prompt handling of missed checks
Report omitted statutory inspections or inadequate repair/maintenance and arrange prompt response with supervisor
Supervisor-facilitated daily pre-work KY and meeting-based KYT; support inexperienced workers
competencies.interpretationNote: Daily rotating presenters are a source suggestion, not a universal requirement; lesson supports inclusive participation.

competencies.topic: Four-round progression: discover hazards, choose focus, generate measures, select team action and confirm it
competencies.interpretationNote: All four conceptual steps are explicitly rewritten; source illustration-sheet artwork is not reproduced.

competencies.topic: Use near-miss information to explain concrete hazards, build sensitivity and connect KY/risk evaluation
Collect events using a defined reporting route/form, share promptly, avoid blame and use improvements
competencies.remainingDetail: Daily end-of-work submission on a common form is not explicit in the lesson; distinguish the source operating example from actual workplace reporting requirements.

competencies.topic: Knowledge or experience shortage requires learning and practice
Familiarity or risk dismissal needs renewed attention to required safe steps
Inattention may occur without deliberate risk dismissal; communication and attention cues
competencies.remainingDetail: The cause is explicitly listed, but its specific corresponding preventive action is compressed into general measures rather than explained as a distinct pairing.

competencies.topic: Communication failures require organisational handover/contact improvements
Group safety-culture weaknesses require collective awareness and improvement
Shortcut/omission behaviour calls for work-culture and compliance improvement
competencies.remainingDetail: The cause is explicitly listed, but its specific corresponding preventive action is compressed into general measures rather than explained as a distinct pairing.

competencies.topic: Overconcentration on one situation requires checking other concurrent conditions
Unexpected events require anticipation and practised responses
Misinterpreting correct information requires checking understanding and directing attention
Physical/mental functional decline requires support and suitable training
Fatigue from long/irregular work requires suitable breaks/rest
Monotony-related loss of attention requires work variations that maintain attention
Software/procedures, equipment/usability, environment and human/hand-over measures instead of blame alone
Choose difficult tasks as well as accidents; split steps; use ECRS; coordinate adjacent work and obtain approval
Find difficult/deformed equipment; consult equipment staff; remove hazards and preserve foolproof/failsafe functions
Identify temperature, humidity, noise and vibration; propose layout/equipment changes; check results and reduce residual burden
competencies.remainingDetail: Temperature/brightness and post-change risks are explicit, but humidity/noise/vibration and checking residual exposure with clothing/work-time options are not taught as a complete sequence.

competencies.topic: Illustrations of reducing energy/sharpness/crushing severity through design
competencies.remainingDetail: General design elimination is covered, but no original worked comparison of severity-reduction examples.
competencies.interpretationNote: Do not transfer the source DC24V example into a universal claim that all electrical injury risk is eliminated.

competencies.topic: Evaluate new/changed equipment, material, methods or deterioration and implement reduction measures
Identify hazards and accident pathways, estimate each risk, prioritise measures, implement
Numeric and non-numeric estimation; likelihood/severity and optional exposure-frequency factors
competencies.interpretationNote: Do not imply every workplace adds or multiplies scores by the same rule.

competencies.topic: Interpret likelihood from barriers/safety-device condition and access to hazard
Distinguish fatal/permanent impairment, lost-time injury, non-lost-time injury and minor first-aid examples
competencies.remainingDetail: Severity is considered, but the full four-category meaning and independent category-reading practice are not present.

competencies.topic: Read a locally specified likelihood/severity lookup matrix and preserve high severity even at low likelihood
competencies.remainingDetail: No explicit independent two-axis lookup exercise is present; source matrix must not be treated as a universal standard.

competencies.topic: Use the stated risk-ranking action table, including high/medium/low and stopping conditions
competencies.remainingDetail: High-priority example is assessed, but medium/low category interpretation is not explicitly taught as a complete table-reading task.

competencies.topic: Implement applicable legal requirements, then elimination/design, engineering, administration and residual-risk PPE
Engineering examples include removing sharp edges, preventing hand entry and automation/remote work
competencies.remainingDetail: Guards/interlocks are explicit, but the range of engineering examples is compressed; one original worked design comparison would strengthen transfer.

competencies.topic: Objective normal-state criteria, patrol/early discovery and accurate state assessment before response
Provisional prohibitions/repair instructions, reporting routes, training and recurrence/analogue prevention
Life-first emergency stopping, secondary-accident prevention, first aid, report actions and know emergency-call criteria
Practise company emergency procedures and cooperate with cause investigation and analogous-event prevention
Prepare first-aid supplies and trained people, oxygen/gas-related protective equipment where relevant, and medical transport plans prioritising ambulance-team directions
competencies.remainingDetail: Supplies/personnel/routes are explicit. Oxygen/gas PPE readiness and prior medical-destination planning with ambulance-team priority are absent.

competencies.topic: Supervisors address workplace health/stress factors and ensure individual pre-work health checks
Review health-check content, observe people who may not disclose symptoms, monitor during work and at departure
Observe changed behaviour, listen/respond, improve work environment and support return to work
competencies.remainingDetail: Observation/listening/escalation are explicit. Support for a worker returning after mental ill-health is absent; environmental stress reduction is only generic.

competencies.topic: Listen and involve limited supervisor/occupational-health personnel; protect mental/physical health information
Recognise changed attendance, overtime, productivity, communication, demeanour, errors, clothing/hygiene and other behaviour without diagnosis
competencies.remainingDetail: Several representative observations are taught; the full illustrative observation list is not exhaustive.
competencies.interpretationNote: Source examples are prompts for sensitive observation, not a diagnostic checklist.

proposedOriginalSupplementParagraphs.targetPosition: after p2 and p3 as sector-local supplementary text
proposedOriginalSupplementParagraphs.draftJa: 救急の準備では、用具の場所と点検、救護を担当する人と訓練を確認します。酸素不足や有害ガスの危険がある職場では、その危険に対応する保護具の整備と点検も担当者と確認します。搬送先の候補を事前に把握していても、実際の搬送では救急隊の指示を優先します。休職後に戻る人への支援も職長の役割です。本人の状況を必要な担当者と確認し、会社の復帰支援方針に沿って仕事や職場環境を調整します。病名や復帰の可否を職長だけで判断せず、健康情報の共有先を限定します。
環境の改善では、温度だけでなく湿度、騒音、振動など、集中や継続作業を妨げる要因を具体的に調べます。配置や設備を変えたら、変更前と後の状態を同じ観点で比較します。改善後にも負担が残るときは、必要な保護具、服装、作業時間の調整を組み合わせて担当者と検討します。危険の除去や設備対策を、保護具だけで置き換える考え方にはしません。

評価表を読むときは、まず発生の可能性を判断する根拠と、起きた場合の被害を別々に整理します。防護カバーがあるという名前だけで判断せず、人が危険な部分に触れ得る状態かを確認します。重大性では、死亡や回復しない障害、休業につながるけが、休業しないけが、処置後に戻れる軽いけがなどの違いを読み取ります。次に、職場が採用した表の行と列を交差させて評価し、その点数に対応する対策と作業停止の条件を確認します。数値や区分は職場の基準に従い、別の表の点数や停止条件を混ぜません。

教材の参照事項は、制度の名称と現場での確認事項を結び付けて整理します。ハラスメント防止では、パワーハラスメント、性的言動や妊娠・出産に関するもの、育児・介護休業に関するものを、それぞれの法制度と会社の相談手順に照らして確認します。品質のISO9001、環境のISO14001、食品安全のISO22000は目的が異なります。FSSC22000、SQF、JFS-Cも名称が似ているという理由で同じ仕組みとみなさず、自社が採用した規格の範囲と要求を担当者に確認します。牛・牛肉の個体識別番号の伝達、米の取引記録や産地情報は、一般の製品ロット管理と関連付けて学びます。食品リサイクル、食品ロス、プラスチック資源循環、労働安全衛生の制度は、それぞれ何を守るための制度かを分けます。教材に記載された年、人数、規格の版や認証条件は資料の時点の情報です。現在の具体的義務を判断するときは、会社の担当部門が確認した最新情報を使います。
proposedOriginalSupplementParagraphs.note: Split by target lesson; do not replace distinct frameworks with one undifferentiated learner paragraph.

sourceDiscrepancyCautions.finding: Illustrative low-voltage example uses absolute language about electrical accidents. Product should teach hazard-energy reduction subject to competent design and actual conditions, not promise universal zero risk from anyDC24Vcircuit.

Historic legal thresholds, scheme-level counts/recognition, policy milestones and targets are edition-bound. This audit verifies what the supplied source says, not current legal or certification status.
